analysis:
The PR adds three optional diagnostic fields to DaemonState: enabledModelsAtStart, enabledModelsAtLastSwitch and selectedModelRecovery. It wires them through the memberwise init (DaemonStateFile.swift head ~340-383) and the custom Codable in DaemonState+Coding.swift (CodingKeys at 13-15, decode at 37-41, encode at 77-81). All three use decodeIfPresent/encodeIfPresent, so older state files still decode. The new keys are additive, so a pre-update watchdog's decoder should ignore them. The existing comment at lines 4-8 addresses the autopilot case only. The schema stays at 1 and the read path still checks it.

No security regression found. The state file carries diagnostic data only. The new fields hold model IDs and a recovery list, with no prompt content (A-001), keys (A-002/A-003), tokens (A-008) or authorization state (A-016). No change touches the coordinator WebSocket (TB-002), the App Attest authorization boundary (TB-011) or the prefix cache (T-041). The file is written atomically at ~/.darkbloom/daemon-state.json and no new trust decision reads it in this diff.

Open items for integration: (1) the definition of SelectedModelRecoveryEntry is not in the supplied evidence. I could not check whether its contents, such as 'what blocked the last one', can include sensitive strings like paths or error messages. (2) The state file's permissions are unchanged and were not reviewed. (3) I did not see the producers (ProviderLoop) or the consumers (status/doctor, watchdog) of the new fields. Nothing visible suggests they are used for authorization.
